description: It creates a free test address at webhook.site, an address that needs no account, so the host can watch deliveries arrive without handing anyone access to their real customer system or mail provider. Take it when a host wants to see a webhook work before it points at something real. "Can I try this without touching my CRM?" It creates a new address at that third party service and nothing on the connected site changes. Every call creates a new address, and an earlier one stays valid. Side effect: it creates a new test address at webhook.site. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: webhook test, test address, try webhook, no account
